status: Root-reviewed source and16synthetic tests; complete six producer inventory fixed before first isolatedreplay. Separate exact source/input freeze required.
profile_inventory: All three canonical and all three five-repeat studies, including adverse results; no bestversion/repeat omission.
dependency_rule: Per fresh profile copy its producer source/input hash maps, own protocol/sourcefreeze and recursively every referenced *_source_freeze.json map. Every current/copy SHA is checked. The profile's own target output directory must not exist until producer runs. Required predecessor identity receipts, such as V2 manifest/audit for V2b, remain allowed; do not copy target producer outputs or old physical arrays opportunistically.
input_freeze: Bind exact driver/test SHA and this plan SHA. Exact input map is the union of all profile transitive dependencies, all original complete manifests and every manifest-declared output SHA. Metadata helpers may build the map, but execution requires the separately frozen exact map. No market parser in this driver.
isolation: One tempfile root per profile; original absolute .venv/bin/python path without resolving its symlink, -I, fresh cwd, PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME removed, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Execute copied script with runpy as __main__, exact --execute --output to fresh expected target. Before and after run require safeinvest/experimental_execution/safeinvest_research package and loaded submodule origins inside fresh root. Record runtime versions/interpreter/prefix/origins and logs.
value_gate: Original complete source/protocol/manifest/outputs and all replay freeze hashes checked first. Every copied producer AST and protocol must retain load_paths(range(1,121),allow_final=False). Same unchanged guarded producer does all numeric replay; this driver never selects policies or opens raw market rows.
comparison: All original root-manifest declared output files, including every repeat manifest, compared. CSV/JSON/gzip bytes exact. NPZ complete inventory/dtype/shape/value with paired NaN exact, and bytehash recorded. Root manifest only drops declared started_utc/completed_utc UTC strings; every other field including all output hashes must match exactly. Missing/extra replay files or any difference fails. Independent audit receipts added after producer completion are not retroactively producer-declared outputs.
archives: Write one unique non-overwrite results directory with incomplete status before gates, per-profile copied dependency hashes/invocation/log/runtime/comparison and final all-original hash snapshot. A failed gate/run/difference retains traceback and current temp workspace, with no silent retry. Passed workspace may be deleted after exact comparison; copied numerical archives need not be stored twice.
interpretation: Same-source same-input same-runtime implementation reproducibility. It adds no independent scenarios, forecasts, risk guarantee, blind validation, policy search or permission to read121-180. All old frozen sources and negative evidence remain unchanged. Stop when declared comparisons are complete.
